meta.name: Snabbit Expert Design Tokens
notes: The installed package is canonical. If this file and the package disagree, the package wins and this file must be updated in the same change.
Dark mode is not defined in 0.19.0. Semantic names are mode-ready; a dark mapping is the next token task.
Palette names (pink600, gray700) are allowed only while building a semantic token the package does not yet expose.
Decisions: Outfit only (Indic falls back to system face). Phosphor Icons only — regular by default, fill for selected/active.

text.name: textInverse
text.use: Text on dark or brand fills

text.name: textSuccess
text.use: Success text and strong positive amount

background.name: bgBrandSubtle
background.use: Soft brand callout or selected wash

typography.rule: Outfit is the only type family. It covers Latin and numerals; Devanagari and Kannada glyphs fall back to the platform system face. Do not add another family.

scale.name: Display
scale.use: Rare hero result or safety state

rules: Use sentence case for UI text.
Use at most three hierarchy levels on one screen.
Do not use Small for actions, errors, payment status, safety guidance, or essential instructions.
Respect system font scaling and verify two-line labels and titles.

fallbackFace.android: Noto Sans Devanagari · Noto Sans Kannada (system)
fallbackFace.ios: Devanagari Sangam MN · Kannada Sangam MN (system)
fallbackFace.rule: Never bundle a second family; the platform face is the fallback and is not styled to imitate Outfit

weightMap.500: Medium where the face has it, else Regular
weightMap.600: SemiBold where the face has it, else Bold
weightMap.rule: Never synthesise bold or italic; the UI uses no italics

expansion.rule: Approximate width of a translated string relative to English at the same size; character budgets in specs are English — the translation must fit the same box

truncationAllowed: ListItem title that opens a detail
indic.note: Indic ascenders/descenders exceed Outfit metrics. Multiply the scale's line height by 1.15 for text containers that may hold Hindi, Marathi or Kannada; text wraps, it is never truncated except in the three named places, and then it is read aloud in full. Numerals are Latin in every language.

scale.use: Default component padding and screen margin
Section gap or spacious screen margin

spacing.rule: Do not add arbitrary 6, 10, 14, 18, or 22 dp layout values. A value owned by a design-system component (6 dp tag gap, 10 dp medium-button radius) is valid only through that component.

scale.name: thicker
scale.use: Selection or strong emphasis — not routine decoration

elevation.rule: The package exposes no global shadow scale in 0.19.0. Default is flat with border/background hierarchy.

scale.name: floating
scale.use: Floating map/control surface already established in app code

scale.name: modal
scale.use: Component-owned — use SnabbitBottomSheet; do not recreate its scrim/elevation

motion.rule: Motion is information or acknowledgement, never decoration. Anything decorative finishes within 300 ms; gestures, timers and loops are exempt because they carry meaning. Animate transform and opacity only.

duration.name: instant
duration.use: Content swaps: skeleton → content, tab content, list updates

duration.name: xfast
duration.use: Key press scale, OTP shake — feedback that must beat the finger

duration.name: fast
duration.use: Pressed washes, fade-outs, small things leaving

duration.name: standard
duration.use: Open / close, slide, expand, indicator moves — the default

duration.name: slow
duration.use: Sheet entering, progress fills, Stepper node completing, value changes

duration.name: emphasis
duration.use: One-shot emphasis: goal-reached bounce, pause / play glyph flash

duration.name: gesture
duration.use: Hold-to-confirm fill (danger Buttons, keypad clear); the gesture's own length

duration.name: beat
duration.use: Pulses that mean live: record dot, urgent Timer digits

duration.name: loop
duration.use: Skeleton shimmer, Coachmark spotlight pulse cycle

easing.name: enter
easing.use: Things arriving: sheets, keypad, toasts, expanding content (ease-out)

easing.name: move
easing.use: Things moving while on screen: tab indicator, page pill, segment

easing.name: linear
easing.use: Anything that measures time: hold fills, Timer ring, progress, shimmer, spin

motion.reducedMotion: When the OS asks for reduced motion: decorative motion becomes a fade of the same duration or instant; motion that carries information (Timer ring draining, progress fill, level meter, the dashed-to-green camera guide) stays; hold gestures show a countdown label instead of a sweep; pulses stop and the state is carried by weight or words.

timeout.rule: Timeouts are behaviour, not animation: how long the app waits before it acts or speaks. They are named so no spec hard-codes a wait.

scale.name: tapGuard
scale.use: After a tap, further taps are ignored (Button, Card, ListItem)

scale.name: loadingMin
scale.use: A spinner or skeleton, once shown, stays at least this long so it never flickers

scale.name: settle
scale.use: After a component appears, before it speaks or plays (Coachmark voice, HowToClip autoplay); also the OTP auto-submit pause

scale.name: screenSettle
scale.use: After a screen appears, before its VoicePrompt bar autoplays

scale.name: loading
scale.use: The three-second rule: after this, loading becomes an honest failure with a way out

scale.name: snackbar
scale.use: Snackbar visible, or until acted on

scale.name: autoAdvance
scale.use: Promotional carousel page dwell; pauses on touch, one loop only

scale.name: autoContinue
scale.use: MediaCapture success overlay before moving on

scale.name: holdSOS
scale.use: SOS hold length — longer than the danger hold on purpose

scale.name: sosCancel
scale.use: Window to cancel a triggered SOS before the call connects

scale.name: expiredClose
scale.use: An expired job alert stays readable before it closes

scale.name: safetyCheck
scale.use: No answer to Are you in danger? is treated as danger

scale.name: jobAlert
scale.use: Server-set window for a job alert (default 90 000); the Timer reads it

icon.rule: Phosphor only. No other icon set, no custom glyphs. One Phosphor icon = one meaning in the app, recorded in foundations/icons.md.

rules: Prefer M for standard actions and L for full-width bottom actions.
XS and S need a 48 dp parent hit area when interactive.
Loading keeps the label visible and adds a spinner.
Disabled and loading states must block duplicate taps.
Use one horizontal margin consistently within a screen.
Cards align to the screen grid.
Bottom actions use 16 dp horizontal/top padding plus the system safe-area inset.
Keep scroll content clear of a persistent footer by the footer height plus safe area.
Do not center long form content in a fixed-width column on phone surfaces.

addingAToken: Confirm the package has no semantic token for the need.
Check this document and the closest existing pattern.
Record the proposed name, value, purpose, affected states, contrast, and migration plan in a component brief.
Prefer adding the token to the design-system package. If temporarily local, isolate it in the app design-system layer, not a feature file.
Update this file, the component library, and affected screenshots in the same change.

illustration.note: Accent hues used only inside illustration assets (foundations/assets.md). purple: hex to be read from the Snabbit Assets Figma file and locked; until then no new asset introduces a purple.
